text:
Riya Das: Quick q — proposing RBAC change + log-curation flow for SIEM to cut costs and reduce PII exposure. Need input on KMS rotation and least-privileged reader roles. TL;DR: keep raw audit in internal S3 for 400d, SIEM gets sanitized subset for 90d (auth events 1yr). Thoughts?

Alex Chen: What exactly do you mean by sanitized subset? Which fields are we sending vs stripping?

Riya Das: Only: event_type, timestamp, actor, resource, action, status, request_id, ip. Strip request_body, response_body, user_email and mask user identifiers. No free-text payloads.

Samir Patel: KMS Q — if we rotate the CMK monthly, will the SIEM ingest break? Who will have Decrypt on the keys?

Alex Chen: As long as the alias points to the new key, Decrypt works for callers with kms:Decrypt on the alias. Problem is cross-account: if SIEM runs in vendor account or separate AWS acct reading SSE-KMS objects, it needs a grant or the target key in its account.

Tara Nguyen: Prefer not to give SIEM decrypt on raw S3 objects. Suggest sanitizer lambda that reads raw-audit (cmk-A), writes sanitized objects to sanitized-siem-bucket encrypted with cmk-B. SIEM gets Decrypt only on cmk-B. Safer separation.

Riya Das: Plan draft: raw-audit-bucket (SSE-KMS cmk-A, retention 400d) -> sanitizer lambda (infra account) -> sanitized-siem-bucket (SSE-KMS cmk-B, retention 90d). For auth-* events, forward to SIEM with 1yr retention. RBAC: create security:log-reader role for sanitized bucket and give SOC-oncall + security team.

Alex Chen: For streaming realtime we can use Kinesis Firehose + transform lambda to strip PII before delivery to SIEM. Firehose can use its own kms key; sink only needs decrypt. Keep the sanitizer approach for batch S3 export.

Samir Patel: We also need to update Console RBAC mapping: limit console 'view_audit_logs' to security and SOC-oncall. Prod SRE gets view_traces but not view_audit_logs. That reduces accidental exposure.

Tara Nguyen: Compliance question — are we okay with 90d in SIEM for most logs? Legal previously asked for 1yr for auth events.

Riya Das: Compliance (looping them in) asked for 1yr for auth/admin events. Proposal: auth-* indices retained 365d (or 1yr), others 90d. We'll maintain three SIEM indices: auth, admin, system.

Alex Chen: Need to update alerting rules and dashboards to point at new indices/names. Also implement hot->warm->cold lifecycle: hot 30d, warm 60d, cold thereafter.

Samir Patel: For KMS rotation monitoring — add a small audit rule that logs kms:Decrypt failures tied to the sanitizer/forwarder IAM role and surface it in the audit index. That'll catch mis-grants after rotation.

Riya Das: Action items:
- Tara Nguyen: prototype sanitizer lambda + minimal transform logic and sample sanitized payload (due 2026-05-08).
- Alex Chen: draft IAM + KMS permission sets and Terraform plan for cmk-A and cmk-B, plus Firehose policy (due 2026-05-10).
- Samir Patel: update Console RBAC mapping + add canary rollout plan for role changes (due 2026-05-12).
I'll loop in @compliance and @sec-ops after these PRs.

Tara Nguyen: Ack — will post a short prototype link and sample S3 object diff when ready.

Alex Chen: Also propose we add a small lambda that re-encrypts key-rotation notifications into the audit index so we have proof of rotation and any Decrypt errors.

AuditBot: Scheduled key-rotation job (cmk-A) will run 2026-05-02T02:00Z. Owners notified: @infra, @security.

Riya Das: Thanks all — tagging sec-ops and legal. If no objections by EOD Friday I'll cut a proposal PR to infra repo with the sanitizer prototype attached. :thumbsup:
